Name: OutfitPreview
Author: pldq
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]OutfitPreview[/b] is a quality-of-life mod that lets you preview clothing items before equipping them — no more guesswork! Simply hover your cursor over any clothing item in your inventory, a shop, a chest, or a dresser, and a real-time preview of your farmer wearing that item appears right next to your cursor.
A handy tooltip also lists all currently equipped outfit pieces, so you can see your full look at a glance.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (version 4.0.0 or later).[/*]
[*]Download the latest release of OutfitPreview.[/*]
[*]Extract the [i]OutfitPreview[/i] folder into your Stardew Valley [i]Mods[/i] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game.[/*]
[/list][heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Real-time preview[/b] — hover over any hat, shirt, pants, or boots to see your farmer wearing it instantly.[/*]
[*][b]Supported screens[/b] — works in your inventory, shops, chests, and dressers.[/*]
[*][b]Layered previews[/b] — hover over a shirt, then a hat, then boots without closing the menu — the preview keeps all previously previewed items, giving you a complete outfit preview.[/*]
[*][b]Current outfit tooltip[/b] — a tooltip next to the preview panel shows the names of all equipped outfit pieces.[/*]
[*][b]Starts from your look[/b] — when you first open a menu, the preview reflects your farmer's actual current appearance.[/*]
[*][b]Seamless integration[/b] — the preview panel positions itself near your mouse cursor and stays within screen bounds.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]No other mods required.[/*]
[/list][heading]Shout Outs[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url] for [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI]SMAPI[/url] and the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI-ModBuildWorkflow]ModBuildWorkflow[/url] — the backbone of Stardew Valley modding.[/*]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/ConcernedApe]ConcernedApe[/url] for creating Stardew Valley.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]简介[/heading]
[b]OutfitPreview[/b] 是一个提升游戏体验的模组，让你在装备服饰之前就能预览效果——告别盲猜！只需将鼠标悬停在物品栏、商店、箱子或梳妆台中的服饰物品上，角色穿戴该物品的实时预览就会出现在光标旁边。
同时还会显示一个便捷的提示框，列出当前已装备的所有服饰名称，让你一目了然地看到完整穿搭。
[heading]安装[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]安装 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]（最低版本 4.0.0）。[/*]
[*]下载 OutfitPreview 的最新版本。[/*]
[*]将解压后的 [i]OutfitPreview [/i]文件夹放入星露谷物语的  [i]Mods [/i]文件夹。[/*]
[*]启动游戏。[/*]
[/list][heading]核心功能[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]实时预览[/b] — 悬停任意帽子、上衣、裤子或鞋子，即可即时看到角色穿戴效果。[/*]
[*][b]支持多种界面[/b] — 适用于物品栏、商店、箱子和梳妆台。[/*]
[*][b]叠加预览[/b] — 不关闭菜单的情况下，依次悬停上衣、帽子、鞋子，预览会将之前悬停的种类全部保留，轻松搭配出完整穿搭。[/*]
[*][b]穿搭提示[/b] — 预览面板旁的工具提示框列出当前已装备的所有服饰名称。[/*]
[*][b]基于当前外观[/b] — 首次打开菜单时，预览形象直接反映角色的实际外观。[/*]
[*][b]无缝集成[/b] — 预览面板自动跟随鼠标位置，并始终保持在屏幕可视区域内。[/*]
[/list][heading]需求[/heading]
[list]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]无需额外模组。[/*]
[/list][heading]致谢[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url] 的 [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI]SMAPI[/url] 和 [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI-ModBuildWorkflow]ModBuildWorkflow[/url] — 星露谷物语模组开发的基石。[/*]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/ConcernedApe]ConcernedApe[/url] 创造了星露谷物语。[/*]
